capabilities: Create a disposable Mail.tm mailbox in one click
Fetch email from a user-configured IMAP server
Save each message as a note with From, To, CC, Subject, Body and attachments
Set note path, name and body with templates and frontmatter
Leave messages unread on the server to preserve read state
extras: Documentation is shipped as a demo vault included with each release and browsable on GitHub; README warns that in Mail.tm mode messages route through the third-party service mail.tm and are retained there up to 7 days, so sensitive information should not be sent.
intentEvidence: Same forwarded-mail goal; ready-made mailbox or own IMAP account
motivation: The author built it because things worth keeping arrive by email and getting them into the vault meant copying, pasting and re-saving attachments by hand.
problem: Getting emails worth keeping into Obsidian requires manually copying, pasting and re-saving message bodies and attachments.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Save emails into Evernote.
Same IMAP goal; ready-made mailbox option; note path/body templates
Same forwarded-mail goal; own IMAP account option and note body templates
Same forwarded-mail goal; ready-made mailbox or own IMAP account
Same forwarded-mail goal; IMAP option and scheduled imports

summary: Email-to-note plugin that saves incoming mail as Obsidian notes via a one-click disposable Mail.tm mailbox or the user's own IMAP server.
